Delhi Police drops case against minor who made remarks against PM Modi

Delhi Police has decided not to file a case against a 15-year-old girl who made abusive remarks against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The girl stated she was influenced by others at a protest and apologized for her remarks. A Zero FIR was initially registered and transferred to Delhi Police jurisdiction. The Prime Minister reportedly urged forgiveness. The decision to drop the case was announced after the Prime Minister's reported call for forgiveness.
